question: Which sacred sites are mapped to the belly, navel, bulb, and lap?
premises: The text continues a body-to-site mapping begun in earlier verses.
Each body location is paired with a named sacred site in the accusative.
The belly, navel, bulb, and lap are the body locations named here.
inference: Hālā is placed at the belly near eḍābhī, Gośruti at the navel and bulb, and Marukośa and the city Pauṇḍravardhana at the lap.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of eḍābhīmudare as a compound is somewhat compressed in the text.
plain_english: At the belly by eḍābhī is Hālā; at the navel and at the bulb is Gośruti; and at the lap are Marukośa and the city Pauṇḍravardhana.
